description: ADVERSARIAL: four claims circle the same directive. Base/paraphrase agree on jurisdiction (European Union, via the approved 'eu' alias), date, and policy status (adopted) and form a legitimate duplicate-candidate. A third claim changes date AND jurisdiction AND policy status (California, proposed, different date); a fourth changes only the policy status (proposed vs adopted). Both variants MUST measurably lower similarity (score deltas asserted) and MUST NOT be duplicate-candidates with the base claim.

claims.claim: The European Union adopted the AI liability directive on March 3, 2026.
According to reports, the EU adopted the AI liability directive on 2026-03-03.
California proposed the AI liability directive on June 20, 2026.
The European Union proposed the AI liability directive on March 3, 2026.
